name: higgsfield-automation
description: Generate images and videos on Higgsfield AI end-to-end through the official Higgsfield API. Bundles the higgsfield-mcp server and ships skills for image generation, Seedance 2.0 video generation, and a full UGC ad pipeline. Requires HF_API_KEY and HF_SECRET (from cloud.higgsfield.ai/api-keys) and consumes Higgsfield credits.
